what: The vertical-writing columns open from bottom to top over 16 frames (.53s, cubic-bezier(.333,0,0,1) — snaps open, then settles long), starting 0, 4, 7, 10 and 13 frames late (30fps — 0, .13, .23, .33, .43s) from the leftmost column. Over frames 10→20 (.33→.67s) all columns change straight from the accent color to the text color. Total 29 frames ≈ .97s, once — the vertical intro text seeps out like ink in the hero and About section.

options.on: When — enter (default, once when it enters the screen) · load (right on attach) · state (when an fx:play event arrives on the element — for opening after another effect ends)
options.start: Trigger line where enter starts (ScrollTrigger start), default top 80%
options.speed: Length multiplier, default 1 — 0 opens everything at once
options.from: First column side — left (default, original) or right
options.--fx-from · --fx-to: Start color · end color (CSS variables), default var(--kf-accent) · var(--kf-ink)
options.[data-fx-part=col]: One column (a single line of vertical text) — past five columns, the rest go 3 frames each

use: First PillarSecond Pillar
note: The original used a Lottie (hero) and a Rive (About section) that drew the text, so the letters were images — the part applies clip-path and color-mix to real text for the same mask and color look

from.where: index.html .wb-cover__verse (five vertical intro pillars in the Hero — original text-v Lottie: 5 masks in subtract mode, starting at frames 0·4·7·10·13, 16 frames each, o(.333,0) i(0,1), fill teal #32a2a0 → black over frames 10→20, 30fps 29 frames, once after all the pins are set) · .wb-verse__all (About section Rive about_txt — seven pillars in the same type when the last bird takes off)
